requirements.title: LEN_TRIM STRING and KIND argument restrictions
requirements.definition: STRING shall be character and KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.LEN_TRIM-STRING-character: Positive source plan calls LEN_TRIM with character scalar arguments; source-control mutation changes STRING to integer and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.LEN_TRIM-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-ex: Positive source plan uses KIND=selected_int_kind(18); source-control mutation changes KIND to a variable and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: LEN_TRIM result is integer with selected kind
requirements.definition: The LEN_TRIM result is integer; KIND selects its kind type parameter and default integer is used without KIND.

pending.LEN_TRIM-result-integer: Assign LEN_TRIM("A  ") to an integer sentinel -777 and assert an exact integer result from the value facet.
pending.LEN_TRIM-result-kind-from-KIND-or-defaul: Assert KIND(LEN_TRIM("A"))==KIND(0) and KIND(LEN_TRIM("A",KIND=selected_int_kind(18)))==selected_int_kind(18); mutate the KIND actual to default in the expected-kind check.

requirements.title: LEN_TRIM counts characters remaining after trailing blanks are removed
requirements.definition: LEN_TRIM returns the number of characters remaining after trailing blanks are removed, and returns zero for an argument containing no nonblank characters.

pending.LEN_TRIM-removes-trailing-blanks: Use "AB   " and assert LEN_TRIM returns 2; mutate to LEN so the trailing blanks are load-bearing.
pending.LEN_TRIM-preserves-internal-blanks: Use "A B  " and assert LEN_TRIM returns 3, proving internal blanks remain counted.
pending.LEN_TRIM-all-blank-zero: Use a length-three all-blank string and assert zero, paired with " A " returning 2 so zero is not a vacuous only result.

review_rationale: Source registration for 16.9.120-16.9.125: LCOBOUND, LEADZ, LEN, LEN_TRIM, LGE and LGT (batch196). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; LCOBOUND runtime facets are out of scope; LEN covers deferred-length allocated and associated characters; LGE and LGT use pairs whose ASCII order differs from plausible native orders. Source accounting only.
